subject.title: tools.exec.approvalRunningNoticeMs is documented but rejected by the 2026.3.24 config schema

question: How should maintainers resolve the open fork PR that claims the exact schema fix while current main remains broken?
rationale: The bug and narrow fix shape are clear, but automation should not open another repair while a linked, non-maintainer-editable fork PR is still open and using closing syntax for this issue.

options.title: Replace with narrow same-repo repair
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork PR and land only the schema/test fix needed for `ToolExecBaseShape`.

options.title: Ask for contributor rebase
options.body: Wait for the fork author to rebase and remove unrelated stale changes, which preserves their branch but may keep the issue blocked.

options.title: Adopt useful commit manually
options.body: Cherry-pick or recreate the useful schema move with attribution if maintainers want to preserve the existing contributor work.

recommendation.title: Replace with narrow same-repo repair
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork PR and land only the schema/test fix needed for `ToolExecBaseShape`.
